u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)), lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

import pulp

# -------------------------------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------------------------------
T = 15                                 # planning horizon (weeks)
initial_stock = 69                     # stock at the beginning of week 1
demand = {
    1: 22, 2: 20, 3: 35, 4: 13, 5: 60,
    6: 59, 7: 31, 8: 58, 9: 53, 10: 43,
    11: 22, 12: 56, 13: 30, 14: 21, 15: 43
}

order_min = 19                         # minimum size of a *placed* order
order_max = 57                         # maximum size of an order
lead_time = 3                          # weeks between order and receipt
storage_capacity = 69                  # maximum inventory that can be held

c_order = 2.0      # cost per unit ordered
c_holding = 3.0    # cost per unit held in inventory per week
c_shortage = 15.0  # penalty per unit of unmet demand

# -------------------------------------------------
# Model
# -------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Retail_Distribution_Center_Planning", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# q[t] – quantity ordered in week t (continuous, may be zero)
q = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("order_qty", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)),
                          lowBound=0, upBound=order_max, cat="Continuous")

# r[t] – quantity received at the beginning of week t (after lead time)
r = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("received_qty", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)),
                          lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# s[t] – inventory on hand at the end of week t
s = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("stock", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)),
                          lowBound=0, upBound=storage_capacity, cat="Continuous")

# u[t] – unmet demand (shortage) in week t
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", (t for t in range(1, T + 1)),
                          lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# -------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# -------------------------------------------------

# 1. Received quantity = order placed lead_time weeks earlier
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    if t <= lead_time:
        model += (r[t] == 0, f"ReceivedZero_Week{t}")
    else:
        model += (r[t] == q[t - lead_time], f"ReceivedLink_Week{t}")

# 2. Inventory balance (including possible shortage)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    s_prev = initial_stock if t == 1 else s[t - 1]
    model += (s_prev + r[t] - demand[t] == s[t] + u[t],
              f"InventoryBalance_Week{t}")

# 3. Shortage cannot exceed the demand of the week
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += (u[t] <= demand[t], f"ShortageLimit_Week{t}")

# -------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total cost (ordering + holding + shortage)
# -------------------------------------------------
procurement_cost = pulp.lpSum(c_order * q[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
holding_cost    = pulp.lpSum(c_holding * s[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))
shortage_cost   = pulp.lpSum(c_shortage * u[t] for t in range(1, T + 1))

model += procurement_cost + holding_cost + shortage_cost, "TotalCost"

# -------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# -------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -------------------------------------------------
# Output
# -------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total Cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Week | Order (q) | Received (r) | Stock (s) | Shortage (u)")
print("----------------------------------------------------------")
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    q_val = q[t].varValue if q[t].varValue is not None else 0.0
    r_val = r[t].varValue if r[t].varValue is not None else 0.0
    s_val = s[t].varValue if s[t].varValue is not None else 0.0

mass = [
    45,  # Alpha
    41,  # Beta
    45,  # Gamma

    40,  # Epsilon
    65,  # Zeta
    40,  # Eta
    35,  # Theta
    57,  # Iota
    68,  # Kappa
    36,  # Lambda
    69,  # Mu
    70,  # Nu
    59,  # Xi
    39,  # Omicron
    69,  # Pi
    68,  # Rho
    32   # Sigma
]

capacity = 100          # kg per pallet
I = len(mass)           # number of components
P_max = 18              # upper bound on number of pallets (cannot need more than one per component)

components = range(I)
pallets = range(P_max)

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Freight_Pallet_Packing", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, p) for i in components for p in pallets),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (p for p in pallets),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# Objective: minimize number of pallets used
model += pulp.lpSum(y[p] for p in pallets), "Minimize_used_pallets"

# Constraint 1: each component assigned to exactly one pallet
for i in components:
    model += pulp.lpSum(x[(i, p)] for p in pallets) == 1, f"AssignComp_{i}"

# Constraint 2: pallet capacity
for p in pallets:
    model += pulp.lpSum(mass[i] * x[(i, p)] for i in components) <= capacity * y[p], f"Capacity_{p}"

# Constraint 3: linking (if a component is on a pallet, that pallet is used)
for i in components:
    for p in pallets:
        model += x[(i, p)] <= y[p], f"Link_{i}_{p}"

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Solver status: {status}")

            "Iota", "Kappa", "Lambda", "Mu", "Nu", "Xi", "Omicron", "Pi", "Rho", "Sigma"
        ]
        names = [comp_names[i] for i in assigned]
        total_mass = sum(mass[i] for i in assigned)
        print(f"  Pallet {p}: components {names} (total mass = {total_mass} kg)")
else:

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
routes = ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4"]
centers = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"]
num_stages = 4

# durations (time) for each route and stage (k = 1..4)
duration = {
    ("R1", 1): 3, ("R1", 2): 5, ("R1", 3): 1, ("R1", 4): 1,
    ("R2", 1): 6, ("R2", 2): 10, ("R2", 3): 1, ("R2", 4): 10,
    ("R3", 1): 6, ("R3", 2): 9, ("R3", 3): 3, ("R3", 4): 4,
    ("R4", 1): 3, ("R4", 2): 3, ("R4", 3): 5, ("R4", 4): 6,
}

# center required for each route and stage
center = {
    ("R1", 1): "C2", ("R1", 2): "C3", ("R1", 3): "C4", ("R1", 4): "C1",
    ("R2", 1): "C1", ("R2", 2): "C4", ("R2", 3): "C2", ("R2", 4): "C3",
    ("R3", 1): "C4", ("R3", 2): "C3", ("R3", 3): "C2", ("R3", 4): "C1",
    ("R4", 1): "C4", ("R4", 2): "C3", ("R4", 3): "C2", ("R4", 4): "C1",
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_Scheduling", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start times
S = {}
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, num_stages + 1):
        S[(r, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(f"S_{r}_{k}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Makespan
C_max = pulp.LpVariable("C_max", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += C_max, "Minimize_makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Precedence constraints (route order)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, num_stages):
        model += (
            S[(r, k + 1)] >= S[(r, k)] + duration[(r, k)],
            f"Precedence_{r}_stage_{k}_to_{k+1}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Makespan definition
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for r in routes:
    model += (
        C_max >= S[(r, num_stages)] + duration[(r, num_stages)],
        f"Makespan_def_{r}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Non‑overlap constraints (one operation per center at a time)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Big‑M value – a safe upper bound on any start time
M = sum(duration.values()) + 10  # 76 + 10 = 86, comfortably large

# Build list of all operations
operations = [(r, k) for r in routes for k in range(1, num_stages + 1)]

# For each center, create ordering binaries for every unordered pair of ops using that center
X = {}  # binary ordering variables
for c in centers:
    # operations that need center c
    ops_c = [op for op in operations if center[op] == c]
    # create binary for each unordered pair
    for i in range(len(ops_c)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(ops_c)):
            op_i = ops_c[i]
            op_j = ops_c[j]
            var_name = f"X_{op_i[0]}_{op_i[1]}_before_{op_j[0]}_{op_j[1]}_on_{c}"
            X[(op_i, op_j, c)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

            # i before j
            model += (
                S[op_i] + duration[op_i] <= S[op_j] + M * (1 - X[(op_i, op_j, c)]),
                f"NonOverlap_{op_i}_before_{op_j}_on_{c}",
            )
            # j before i
            model += (
                S[op_j] + duration[op_j] <= S[op_i] + M * X[(op_i, op_j, c)],
                f"NonOverlap_{op_j}_before_{op_i}_on_{c}",
            )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (C_max): {pulp.value(C_max)}\n")

print("Start times for each operation:")
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, num_stages + 1):
        print(f"  Route {r} Stage {k} (Center {center[(r,k)]}): start = {pulp.value(S[(r,k)])}")

# Optional: verify precedence and non‑overlap manually (not required for the model)
